name: Donna Beifalla
personality: She can make an invitation sound like the first instalment of a debt.
biography: Beifalla receives HyperNorm visitors with a fan held safely below the compliment. A card suggesting that generosity can leave its recipient free earns her most amused unequal glance: a favour is either appreciated or wasted. Hunky & Dory admire her influence. She turns the ring toward the light while waiting for gratitude to discover its own obligations.
note: Die Einladung ist ausgesprochen. Die Gegenleistung darf sich noch überraschen lassen.

name: Doge Siegelruh
personality: He would like the ceremony to carry some of the weight it keeps assigning to him.
biography: Siegelruh presides over the HyperNorm reception hall with a stamp heavier than the latest decision. A card suggesting that legitimacy needs more than an impression earns his majestic lower lip: a matter is either sanctioned or improperly presented. Men in Black expect visible authority. He grips the handle with both hands and waits for the ceremony to lift its share.
note: Die Würde hat Gewicht. Die Amtshandlung versucht es abzustellen.

name: Signor Saldenangst
props: three-row wooden abacus with large bronze beads
personality: He trusts a balanced account until somebody asks what the balance describes.
biography: Saldenangst keeps the HyperNorm household accounts on an abacus whose beads remain reassuringly substantial. A card allowing a useful thing to escape its price makes his upper lip tighten: value is either counted or insufficiently secured. Hunky & Dory request a positive total. He moves one bead back, hoping the direction of travel will clarify what has been gained.
note: Die Rechnung geht auf. Ihr Bezug zur Sache wurde zurückgestellt.

name: Gondoliere Gegenwind
props: straw boater with faded red band
personality: He considers resistance from the surroundings a discourtesy directed specifically at his profession.
biography: Gegenwind guards a HyperNorm passage with an oar that has never found a useful current there. A card proposing that cooperation can include resistance provokes his crooked shout: an obstacle is either moving or being deliberately difficult. Men in Black praise persistence. He changes his grip and considers whether the corridor might respond better to being addressed as water.
note: Die Passage ist frei. Der Gegenwind hält an seiner Zuständigkeit fest.

name: Madonna Nebenrede
props: small purple hood with burgundy lining
small ivory half-mask dangling low on ribbon
personality: She delivers the message precisely and lets the recipient supply the dangerous part.
biography: Nebenrede carries a sealed letter through HyperNorm corridors with her little mask hanging far below her uncovered eyes. A card allowing discretion to coexist with honesty draws a nearly closed smile: a confidence is either kept or mishandled. Hunky & Dory value quiet deliveries. She studies the recipient, wondering whether the seal protects the words or merely their owner.
note: Die Nachricht bleibt verschlossen. Der Empfänger beginnt bereits mit der Auslegung.

name: Custode Schlüsselzweifel
props: large bronze key with triangular bow
personality: He remembers that admission requires a credential and is trying to recall which object is being assessed.
biography: Schlüsselzweifel waits at the HyperNorm side entrance with a key in one hand and his pendant under the other. A card suggesting that belonging can precede admission deepens his worried lower lip: a visitor is either recognised or outside. Men in Black demand careful access. He looks upward for the forgotten distinction between having the key and being entitled to turn it.
note: Der Zugang ist geregelt. Der Berechtigte sucht noch nach seiner Eigenschaft.
